Short Summary: Verify unauthorized storage accounts do not have public network access enabled (e.g., by using Azure built-in policy "Storage accounts should disable public network access" in Audit mode).
Verify versioning is enabled on required containers (e.g., by using Azure built-in policy "Configure your Storage account to enable blob versioning" in Audit mode).
Verify snapshots are enabled for required file shares (e.g., by using a custom Azure Policy on {"properties.shareSnapshotEnabled": false} in Audit mode).
Wiz Built-in CCR Mapping (If Applicable): N/A (Azure Files has no setting that turns share snapshots on; snapshots are taken on demand or by an Azure Backup policy, outside the storage account)

Short Summary: Verify required storage accounts have the blob soft-delete option enabled (e.g., by using custom Azure Policy in Audit mode).
Verify required storage accounts have container soft delete enabled (e.g., by using a custom Azure Policy in Audit mode).
Verify only required storage accounts have the hierarchical namespace (HNS) option enabled (e.g., by using a custom Azure Policy on {"isHnsEnabled": "true"} in Audit mode).
Verify SAS tokens are used only for authorized storage accounts, services, permissions, expiration, and access methods.
Wiz Built-in CCR Mapping (If Applicable): StorageAccount-028 (Partial: checks that a SAS expiration policy exists, not its maximum period or that longer tokens are blocked)

Short Summary: Verify only authorized private endpoints are configured on storage accounts (e.g., by using the built-in Azure Policy "Storage accounts should use Private Link" in Audit mode).
Wiz Built-in CCR Mapping (If Applicable): StorageAccount-029 (Partial: checks that an approved private endpoint exists, not that each endpoint is authorized)

Short Summary: Verify storage account firewall rules allow only authorized IPs (e.g., by using built-in Azure Policy "Storage accounts should restrict network access" in Audit mode).
Wiz Built-in CCR Mapping (If Applicable): StorageAccount-041 (Partial: flags rules open to 0.0.0.0/0 only, not other unauthorized IP ranges)

Short Summary: Verify only the storage accounts that require cross-tenant replication have it enabled (e.g., by using the Azure built-in policy StorageAccountAllowCrossTenantReplication_Audit.json).
Verify storage accounts have diagnostic settings configured (e.g., by using built-in Azure Policy "Configure diagnostic settings for storage accounts to Log Analytics workspace" in Audit mode).

Verify only required blobs or containers are anonymously accessible (e.g., by using a custom Azure Policy on {"Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/blobServices/containers/publicAccess": "Blob"} in Audit mode).

Verify only authorized customer-managed keys are configured for storage accounts (e.g., by using the built-in Azure Policy "Storage accounts should use customer-managed key for encryption" in Audit mode).
Wiz Built-in CCR Mapping (If Applicable): StorageAccount-007 (Partial: checks that a customer-managed key is used, not that it is an authorized key)

Short Summary: Verify required storage accounts use redundancy (e.g., by using a custom Azure Policy on {"Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/sku.name": ["Standard_GRS","Standard_ZRS"]} in Audit mode).
Verify only the authorized storage account region is set for redundancy (e.g., by using a custom Azure Policy with {"location": ["eastus","westeurope"]} in Audit mode).

Verify Shared Key authorization is disabled (and optionally that OAuth is the default) for authorized storage accounts that host authorized blobs, file shares, queues, tables, and DFS (e.g., by using a custom Azure Policy to require "Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/allowSharedKeyAccess" = false and, optionally, "Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/defaultToOAuthAuthentication" = true in Audit mode).
Wiz Built-in CCR Mapping (If Applicable): StorageAccount-026 (Partial: flags every account that allows Shared Key, with no way to authorize the accounts that need it), StorageAccount-043 (Partial: OAuth default only)

Short Summary: Verify all file shares have the soft-delete option enabled (e.g., by using a custom Azure Policy on {"Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/fileServices/shares/deleteRetentionPolicy.enabled": false} in Audit mode).
Verify storage account keys and Shared Key authorization are managed according to authorized use, key rotation, and Shared Key authorization requirements.
Wiz Built-in CCR Mapping (If Applicable): StorageAccount-017 (Partial: checks that a key expiration policy exists, not its length), StorageAccount-052 (Partial: fixed 90-day maximum), StorageAccount-056 (Partial: fixed 180-day rotation)

Short Summary: Verify storage accounts that do not require static website hosting do not have it enabled (e.g., by using a custom Azure Policy on {"Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/staticWebsite.enabled": true} in Audit mode).

Verify only authorized CORS trusted origins and corresponding settings are configured (e.g., by using a custom Azure Policy on {"Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/blobServices/cors.allowedOrigins[*]": ["https://myapp.contoso.com"]} in Audit mode).

Verify only file shares that require NFS/SMB 2.1 have it enabled (e.g., by using a custom Azure Policy on {"Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/fileServices/protocolSettings.smb.protocolVersions[*]": ["SMB2.1"]} in Audit mode).
Wiz Built-in CCR Mapping (If Applicable): StorageAccount-034 (Partial: checks the SMB version floor only, not which file shares may use NFS or SMB 2.1)

Short Summary: Verify required storage accounts use malware scanning for uploaded blob content (e.g., by using Microsoft Defender for Storage malware scanning).
Verify required storage accounts use Azure resource locks (e.g., by using built-in Azure Policy "Resource locks should be applied" in Audit mode).
Supported Modes: Allowlist (Terraform matcher only), Universal (Terraform matcher only)

Short Summary: Verify only storage accounts that require SFTP have it enabled (e.g., by using a custom Azure Policy on {"Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/isSftpEnabled": true} in Audit mode).

Verify required file shares' security protocol settings are configured (e.g., by using a custom Azure Policy on {"Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/fileServices/protocolSettings.smb": {"kerberosTicketEncryption":"AES256","channelEncryption":"Required"}} in Audit mode).
Wiz Built-in CCR Mapping (If Applicable): StorageAccount-037 (Partial: flags NTLMv2 only), StorageAccount-038 (Partial: flags RC4-HMAC only), StorageAccount-053 (Partial: SMB channel encryption only)

Short Summary: Verify storage accounts use authorized account types (e.g., by using Azure built-in policy "Storage accounts should be migrated to new Azure Resource Manager resources" in Audit mode).
Wiz Built-in CCR Mapping (If Applicable): StorageAccount-021 (Partial: checks the pricing tier, not the account type)

Short Summary: Verify required storage container blobs have immutability policies enabled (e.g., by using the built-in Azure Policy "Immutable blob storage should be enabled" in Audit mode).
Wiz Built-in CCR Mapping (If Applicable): StorageAccount-047 (Partial: locked account-level version immutability only, not policies on the containers you require)

Short Summary: Verify replication policies and their destination storage accounts are authorized (e.g., by using a custom Azure Policy on "Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/objectReplicationPolicies[*].destinationAccount" and "Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/objectReplicationPolicies[*].rules[*].sourceContainer" in Audit mode).
Verify stored access policies and their permissions are authorized for each container, file share, queue, and table.
Wiz Built-in CCR Mapping (If Applicable): StorageAccount-042 (Partial: file shares granting every permission only), StorageAccount-039 (Partial: tables granting every permission only)

Short Summary: Verify Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 functionality is enabled only where Access Control Lists (ACLs) on containers are authorized (e.g., by using a custom Azure Policy to detect storage accounts where "Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/isHnsEnabled" = true and "Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/allowSharedKeyAccess" = true, in Audit mode).

Verify local user functionality for SFTP is enabled only where local users, their permissions, and authentication methods are authorized (e.g., by using a custom Azure Policy to detect storage accounts where "Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/localUsersEnabled" = true and "Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/isSftpEnabled" = true, in Audit mode).
Wiz Built-in CCR Mapping (If Applicable): StorageAccount-044 (Partial: checks that local users are disabled, not which local users and permissions are authorized)

Short Summary: Verify only authorized identities and access methods can read, peek, or dequeue storage queue messages.

Short Summary: Verify each storage account uses only authorized virtual network rules (e.g., by using Azure built-in policy "Storage accounts should restrict network access using virtual network rules" in Audit mode).
Wiz Built-in CCR Mapping (If Applicable): StorageAccount-031 (Partial: checks that a virtual network rule exists, not that each rule is authorized)

Short Summary: Verify each storage account uses only authorized network ACL bypass configurations (e.g., by using Azure built-in policy "Storage Accounts should restrict network access through network ACL bypass configuration only" in Audit mode).

Short Summary: Verify required storage accounts use Azure infrastructure encryption (e.g., by using Azure built-in policy "Storage accounts should have infrastructure encryption" in Audit mode).
